combo_label: Tools & DIY × Cycling × The Wild West

entries.clue: Studs under a shoe that click you firmly into the pedals
Looped rope a rider whirls overhead to catch a running calf
Slim wire running from a wheel's middle out to its edge
Swing-door drinking den with a piano and a card game in the corner
Sturdy shed table, scarred and oil-stained, where the making happens
Slim steel spike driven flush with a few sharp taps
Hip pouch of stitched leather that keeps a pistol handy
Clear plastic eye shields worn before anything starts throwing sparks
White, sticky and clamped overnight, it makes two offcuts one
Small hole that lets the air out and the swearing in
